fast.notes: qwen3: fast (about 1.7 s per action), no rate limit seen up to 360 req/min (D-027). Best on Greed and the real-time games; cannot solve Zork or DCSS (D-037).

glm-flash.notes: GLM-4.7-Flash: fast, plays live through toolfix (D-028, D-029).

thinker.notes: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash: solves Zork (40) and reaches DCSS Dungeon:2 (D-037). Workers AI caps it at about 36 req/min per account, so pace each lane at 7 s.

glm53.notes: GLM-5.3: strong on Zork (49) but 18-240 s per action across 6 lanes, many stalls (D-037). Use when speed does not matter.

opus-fast.notes: Claude Opus 5.5 in fast mode (beta fast-mode-2026-02-01, speed fast, effort low) through the broker's /anthropic route. Fast mode is $8/$40 per MTok, 2x standard Opus.

haiku.notes: Claude Haiku 5.5 (effort low) through the broker's /anthropic route. $0.10/$0.50 per MTok.

local.notes: Gemma 4 26B-A4B (MoE, 4B active) served by LM Studio on the host (127.0.0.1:1234, reached from host_ip lanes at 100.64.255.254:1234). About 1 s for a 1K-token prompt, native tool calls, no toolfix, no spend. qwen3.8-27b-mlx was tried first: it ignores enable_thinking=false and spends 13 s reasoning per turn.

@cf/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash.notes: Probe 2026-10-21: 0% 429s at 30 req/min, 70% 429s at 60 req/min; sustains about 36 req/min. 4 lanes at 7 s = about 34 req/min.

@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3.notes: Slow: 18-240 s per action across 6 lanes (D-037).

@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3-flash.notes: Slow: p95 13 s even at 15 req/min, reasons unless reasoning_effort is low (probe 2026-10-21). Too slow to play.

claude-opus-5-5.notes: Fast mode has its own rate limit, separate from standard Opus. The broker's Anthropic key needs credit (2026-10-21: 'credit balance is too low').

gemma-4-26b-a4b-it-qat-mlx.notes: One local model on the Mac: LM Studio serves requests one at a time.
